title: Show ownership in a behavioral interview
summary: Kể STAR story có hành động cá nhân, kết quả đo được và reflection.

sections.title: Weak interview answer
sections.content: We had a production problem. We worked hard and fixed it. Everyone was happy and I learned a lot.

exercises.question: Chi tiết nào cải thiện câu trả lời nhiều nhất?
options: I introduced a rollback checklist that reduced recovery time from 40 to 12 minutes.
correctAnswer: I introduced a rollback checklist that reduced recovery time from 40 to 12 minutes.
exercises.explanation: Câu này nêu hành động cá nhân và kết quả đo được.

performanceTask.title: Tell an ownership story
performanceTask.scenario: Interviewer hỏi về lúc bạn chủ động xử lý một production problem.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Trả lời cold question mà chưa xem model/chunks.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Trong 2 phút, giữ situation/task ngắn, làm rõ hành động của bạn, result đo được và lesson.
performanceTask.modelResponse: During a payment incident, rollback took forty minutes because ownership was unclear. I coordinated recovery and ran the rollback. Afterwards, I created a checklist and named a rollback owner for every release. The next incident recovered in twelve minutes. I learned that ownership includes improving the system after the immediate fix.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Kể incident queue backlog mới; rút gọn context và làm rõ I-action/result.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Không xem model/chunks: kể lúc bạn chủ động ngăn certificate expiry thành incident.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Kể một ownership story mới về data-quality risk bằng STAR và evidence.

baseline.title: Payment rollback
baseline.brief: Recovery chậm vì ownership không rõ.

artifacts.title: Incident facts
artifacts.content: Rollback: 40 min; you coordinated recovery; you created checklist + named owner; next recovery: 12 min.

retry.title: Queue backlog
retry.brief: Dùng story khác nhưng giữ ownership function.

artifacts.title: Backlog facts
artifacts.content: Queue delay: 55 min; you proposed autoscaling guardrail and dashboard; later peak delay: 8 min.

artifacts.title: Risk facts
artifacts.content: Certificate expired in 9 days; no owner; you added rotation job + alert + runbook; renewal completed 6 days early.

artifacts.title: Quality facts
artifacts.content: Duplicate events affected 3% reports; you added idempotency key and audit query; duplicates fell below 0.1%.

rubric.label: Concise STAR structure
rubric.description: Keeps situation and task brief enough to foreground action.

rubric.label: Personal ownership
rubric.description: Uses specific I-statements for decisions and actions.

rubric.label: Result and learning
rubric.description: Provides a measurable outcome and a credible lesson.

audio.text: Recovery time fell from forty to twelve minutes.
Looking back, I would add the alert earlier.
The incident affected checkout for twenty minutes.
I profiled the query and proposed batching.

training.question: What proves ownership?
training.feedback: Stress I and the action verbs; do not overuse we.

audio.text: As a result, p ninety-five fell to five hundred milliseconds.
The situation was urgent, so I kept the context brief.

training.question: What stays brief?
training.feedback: Keep situation short so action remains prominent.

audio.text: I introduced alerts and tested the runbook.

training.question: How many actions are named?
training.feedback: Keep final sounds in alerts and tested audible.

audio.text: What I learned was to assign an owner before release.

training.question: What part of STAR is this?

audio.text: The change reduced failures by twenty-eight percent.
I added a rotation job and wrote the runbook.
Duplicate reports fell below zero point one percent.
Next time, I would validate ownership during planning.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Nhấn I + action verb; giữ âm cuối trong profiled, proposed, alerts, tested.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Mờ chủ thể/action khiến ownership nghe như công sức chung không xác định.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Tạo một thought group riêng cho AS A RESULT + con số.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Con số chìm làm evidence khó được interviewer bắt kịp.

modelAudio.text: During a payment incident, we faced a slow rollback.

chunks.meaning: Làm rõ quyết định cá nhân.

modelAudio.text: I decided to coordinate the rollback because ownership was unclear.

chunks.text: As a result, ___ changed from ___ to ___.

modelAudio.text: As a result, recovery changed from forty to twelve minutes.

chunks.text: What I learned was ___; next time, I would ___.

modelAudio.text: What I learned was to assign ownership early; next time, I would verify it during planning.

listenBackChecklist: I-actions và con số nghe rõ.
Reflection có future action cụ thể.

interactionTurns.prompt: What did you personally decide, rather than the team?
interactionTurns.expectedFunction: separate personal decision from team work
